home.title: Learn languages by reading short stories
home.subtitle: Read in the language you’re learning and reveal the translation of each passage only when you need it.
home.benefit1Desc: New words appear inside a story, and their meaning comes from context.
home.benefit2Desc: Every passage keeps its translation hidden. Try to understand first, then check.
home.benefit3Desc: Pick your languages and start reading. No account, no password.
home.readySub: Choose your languages. You can change them anytime at the top of the page.
